messages:
Priya: heads up — Acme (acct_1234) opened a support case: their month-end invoice shows an extra 'embeddings' line for Oct 31 that doesn't appear on the dashboard. they emailed csv + invoice id INV-20241031-ACME. can we triage? timezone was UTC-7 for cutoff.
Alex: on it. can you paste the invoice line or a small sample of the CSV rows? also need invoice id and any request ids customer provided.
Priya: copy paste from invoice PDF (redacted):
```
INV-20241031-ACME
line: embeddings 
units: 1,234,567 tokens
unit_price: $0.0004
amount: $493.83
notes: backend processing 2024-11-01T00:03:12Z
```
customer also sent dashboard export showing 0 embeddings lines for that day.
BillingBot: ingestion-monitor: ingest job completed for acct_1234 at 2024-11-01T00:05:18Z, job_id=ingest-20241101-7f3, rows=3200, backfill=false
Omar: I pulled infra logs quickly. there was a retry/backfill window around midnight:
```
2024-10-31T23:49:50Z embed_batch.batch-7742 started
2024-11-01T00:00:05Z embed_batch.batch-7742 retry triggered (downstream timeout)
2024-11-01T00:03:10Z embed_batch.batch-7742 completed, ids processed: 3200
```
looks like a retry caused the same rows to be re-ingested to billing_snapshot without the dedupe flag set.
Alex: dashboard uses usage_live aggregated table which ignores rows where reprocessed=true. invoice generator reads billing_snapshot (snapshot job) which was populated by the ingest path. If the backfill path didn't mark reprocessed=true, duplicates could show up on the invoice but not on the dashboard.
Nate: that would explain the delta in totals. if duplicates landed in billing_snapshot after the dashboard agg, invoice would include them. how big is the delta in $ terms from that sample? ~ $494 for the line on invoice.
Priya: customer expects a reconciliation number and either a credit or corrected invoice. they asked for ETA by EOD PST.
Alex: plan of action: 1) run diff query between billing_snapshot rows for acct_1234 and usage_live for Oct 31 to identify duplicate groups; 2) if duplicates confirmed, prepare a credit (or corrected invoice) and rollback snapshot rows; 3) patch backfill to set reprocessed flag. Omar — can you confirm whether backfill_v2 has an open PR?
Omar: confirmed. there is a PR that fixes dedupe_flag for backfill_v2 (PR #4128). deployment is staged to canary and awaiting one more thumb. root cause: when retry path executed, it used legacy ingestion shim that didn't set reprocessed=true. the PR forces dedupe flag set for legacy shim too.
Sam: I'll take customer comms once we have confirm. do we have an estimated time to run diff + issue credit?
Alex: diff query should be <30m. if duplicates found, finance approval for credit — Nate, can you approve an immediate prorated credit up to the invoice line amount if it's clearly a duplication?
Nate: yes, finance approves provisional credit up to the line amount pending final validation. please attach results.
Priya: noted. I told customer we'll update within 3 hours. they're pretty urgent but calm.
Alex: running the query now, sharing results in ~20m. if match = duplicate, we'll do: credit + corrected invoice + note about root cause and ETA for fix.
Priya: thanks. tagging @Omar when PR merges can you post deploy id so we can confirm no further duplicates.
Omar: will do, PR merge and canary deploy planned within the hour after validation. deploy id will be deploy-20241101-canary-89.
BillingBot: backfill-runner: flagged job embed_batch.batch-7742 as reprocessed=true at 2024-11-01T00:25:42Z (auto-flag after manual fix)
Alex: results: diff found 3,200 duplicate embed token rows in billing_snapshot that are not in usage_live (exact match on id set). amounts match invoice line. marking for removal and credit.
Nate: finance has created a provisional credit CR-20241101-ACME for $493.83; will post to invoice system after you mark rows for correction.
Sam: customer update draft: "we found duplicate ingestion during a midnight retry that resulted in an extra embeddings line on your invoice. we've issued a provisional credit and will correct the invoice. final confirmation by EOD." want me to send?
Priya: send it. please include the invoice id and provisional credit id. thanks everyone. :thumbsup!
Alex: followups: - file a postmortem for the ingestion shim retry path - add a monitoring alert for unusually high embedding-only invoice lines at cutoff - verify snapshot vs live parity during next cutover.
Omar: will cut postmortem and merge PR after canary looks good. thanks all.
